{{Quote|I've had some experience with the Wookiees. They won't be taken into captivity without a fight.''"<br />"''I fully expect a fight, Commander.|A [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="DLTRoDV" />}}
The '''Kashyyyk resistance''', also known as the '''Wookiee underground resistance movement''' or as the '''Wookiee resistance''', was the name given to informal groups of resistance fighters that opposed the [[Enslavement of Kashyyyk|oppression]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that had turned Kashyyyk into a [[slave world]].

==Overview==
{{Quote|Wookiees do not take lightly to the threat of captivity. Already they're abandoning the tree-cities for the high forests. If they penetrate deeply enough, we will need months, perhaps years to find and root them out. Even then, the cost to us will be great, in terms of materiel and lives.|A clone commander, to Darth Vader|<ref name="DLTRoDV" />}}
The Kashyyyk Resistance fought against the machinations of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. This was because of the Imperial practice of capturing Wookiees in order to use them for [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor and at its peak, the Kashyyyk Resistance desperately fought for its survival as well as freeing their people from a reign of tyranny. The Resistance was mostly formed from Wookiee's who had broken the shackles of slavery and managed to flee into the jungles of their homeworld. Hiding within the dense jungles of Kashyyyk, they used the trees to move about undetected and strike from these positions. After the attack, they quickly retreated back into the trees and any Imperial pursuit normally suffered a high rate of casualties. The organization had a single objective which was freeing their people from slavery and removing the Empire's presence from their homeworld. This sees them sabotaging Imperial operations and attempting to increase their numbers by striking targets where their captive kin were imprisoned. Sometimes, these freed Wookiee's were encouraged to escape off-world and the Resistance conducted actions to ensure that as many of their kind were able to escape to other planets.<ref name="GoI" />

[[File:Wookiee_resistance.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Wookiee freedom fighters during the Galactic Civil War.]]
Though lacking a formal organization, the Resistance was formed when a band of Wookiees decided to stand up against their oppressors leading to the formation of cells with defined leaders of this small groups. At times, separate cells could merge together to form a larger group though this act was often dangerous as the Empire was ruthless and zealous in its attempts at exterminating any signs of rebellious movements on their [[slave world]]s. This prevented the Kashyyyk Resistance from being an organized group and forced them to maintain only sporadic contact with another to the point that many of its members were unaware that there were other resistance fighters around the world. On rare occasions, the multiple group of Wookiee Freedom Fighters formed together in a joint operation to strike a blow against the Empire but the Imperial response was usually swift and brutal.<ref name="GoI" />

During certain moments, the Kashyyyk Resistance was aided by outside elements such as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] which saw the group benefiting from the resources of another organization but maintained the ferocity as well as local knowledge of the Wookiees. Local traders and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] were known to also support the Wookiee's by helping them to evacuvate their families or to engage Imperial slave transports.<ref name="GoI" />

Though Wookiee's were known for their great strength, the Kashyyyk Resistance was known to use advanced equipment to support their goals. This included the use of traditional [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]], devastating grenade launchers and the actions of [[Probe droid/Legends|recon droids]]. A linked series of [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] were used to remotely use the recon [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were used to scout nearby areas and were equipped with explosive charges to eliminate hidden targets. They were also known to had retrofitted [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|Oevvaor jet catamaran]] so that they could be used to fight off Imperial gunships or landers.<ref name="GoI" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Empire, of course. They are not interested in sending valuable soldiers all the way out here to help squelch this resistance but at the same time they cannot just turn a blind eye to those disobedient furballs.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gurnst]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TFB">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Task Force Bravo|Kashyyyk}}</ref>}}
[[File:SecondBattleOfKashyyyk.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] fighting Wookiees.]]
The Kashyyyk Resistance was first formed during the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] where it [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|battled]] against the assaults from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="GoI" /> However, soon after the creation of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Wookiees massively [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|revolted]] against the Empire. Thousands of Wookiees warriors fought [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[clone stormtrooper]]s but they were severely defeated due to the overwhelming use of [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] by Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. After the battle, 200,000 captured Wookiees were enslaved by the Empire.<ref name="DLTRoDV" /> Another large [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|battle]] took place about one year later and was similarly crushed by Darth Vader.<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], during the early days [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Wookiee underground resistance movement was active in [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] and led by [[Katarra]]. [[Jowdrrl]] and [[Ralera]] were also members. During that time, Katarra's resistance group was supported by [[Bria Tharen]] of the [[Corellian Resistance/Legends|Corellian Resistance]].<ref name="RD" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Wookiee Resistance was very active in the area around [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]]. However, the Galactic Empire was not willing to lose valuable soldiers in fighting the Wookiee resistance anymore. The Empire therefore contracted the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] of [[Task Force Bravo]] led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gurnst]] to crush the resistance.<ref name="SWG:TFB" /> A resistance leader during this period was the Wookiee [[warrior]] [[Ulaaar]].<ref name="Assault Team" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Kashyyyk Resistance was able to build a large army supported by various war vehicles.<ref name="GB" /> Kashyyyk was finally [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|freed]] of the Empire in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a few months after the Battle of Endor. While the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] navy defeated the Imperial fleet in orbit,<ref name="TNEC" /> all the battles on the surface of Kashyyyk were fought by the Wookiee resistance.<ref name="GB" />
